title: FancyZones CLI: ls fails on first use with missing layout-templates.json
summary: FancyZones CLI ls fails on first use with missing layout-templates.json; open non-draft PR #52187 now includes the missing-file fallback and reported tests but is not merged.
next_action: Review the current #52187 head and verify first-run/saved-layout behavior before treating the issue as shipped.

judgment.rationale: Open non-draft PR #52187 directly covers the first-run listing failure with default templates, empty custom layouts and focused regression tests. The PR is still open and not shipped; review that exact implementation rather than proposing competing work.
evidence: The report shows ls failing with File not found: layout-templates.json and succeeding after the first editor save.
Affected release/install method are not supplied; source inspection is not claimed as runtime validation.
No comments or assignees are present.

Current GetLayoutsCommand.Execute reads templates and custom layouts unconditionally: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/00d85a4c73c2ec33da7a9c25d1a3581b3d4c4359/src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesCLI/CommandLine/Commands/GetLayoutsCommand.cs

Current FancyZonesDataIO.ReadData throws when either file is absent: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/00d85a4c73c2ec33da7a9c25d1a3581b3d4c4359/src/modules/fancyzones/FancyZonesEditorCommon/Utils/FancyZonesDataIO.cs

Read the live #52187 body and all three changed files. Its shared-reader fallback covers both files independently, preserves saved and malformed-file behavior, and adds focused tests: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/pull/52187

Related #52191 distinguishes the correct public shim from an unrelated help-name issue; this report reached the CLI and failed on configuration, not command resolution: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/52191
judgment.recommended_action: Review and validate open PR #52187 against the fresh-state and saved-value matrix; do not propose a competing fix or describe it as shipped.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR #52187 is an open, non-draft implementation that directly covers missing first-run layout files. The PR description reports the focused regression suite and CLI smoke checks passing; it has not merged, so no shipped resolution is claimed.

reproduce.title: Check current PR #52187 against first-use FancyZones CLI cases
reproduce.version_requirement: Installed build containing the reported CLI; record exact version
prerequisites: A disposable Windows user profile and a baseline build plus a build from PR #52187 exact head 045a81bcf27711dc776e1eaa928acbf9a6ba7fc7; record version/channel. FancyZones enabled. Resolve the installer-provided bin shim PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe or invoke that shim by full path; do not change global PATH.
setup: Use a fresh disposable user profile with FancyZones enabled, not an existing user's layouts.
steps: 1. On the baseline build, before opening or saving the editor in the disposable profile, run PowerToys.FancyZones.CLI.exe ls and get-layouts; record output, exit code and whether either command creates a layout file.
2. On the PR #52187 head, repeat both commands in an equally fresh disposable profile; confirm built-in templates appear and no custom layouts are listed or written.
3. Save a layout in the editor on the PR build and repeat both aliases; confirm saved custom layouts and template overrides remain authoritative.

4. In disposable fixtures for the shared readers, test each independent present/absent file combination and malformed existing JSON; absence should use defaults, malformed files should still report errors.
reproduce.expected_result: The baseline reproduces the missing-file failure; PR #52187 returns built-in templates and no custom layouts without creating files, preserves saved values, and still reports malformed-file errors.
